_comment: Texts used only by the Android app. Shared texts live in shared.json (generated, do not duplicate them here).

Glassbed needs access to your local netw.en: Glassbed needs access to your local network to find and use your printer. It connects to nothing else.
Glassbed needs access to your local netw.de: Glassbed braucht Zugriff auf dein lokales Netzwerk, um deinen Drucker zu finden und zu nutzen. Mit nichts anderem wird eine Verbindung hergestellt.
Glassbed needs access to your local netw.tr: Glassbed, yazıcınızı bulmak ve kullanmak için yerel ağınıza erişmeye ihtiyaç duyar. Başka hiçbir yere bağlanmaz.

Without access to the local network Glas.en: Without access to the local network Glassbed cannot reach your printer. You can allow it in the system settings.
Without access to the local network Glas.de: Ohne Zugriff auf das lokale Netzwerk kann Glassbed deinen Drucker nicht erreichen. Du kannst ihn in den Systemeinstellungen erlauben.
Without access to the local network Glas.tr: Yerel ağa erişim olmadan Glassbed yazıcınıza ulaşamaz. Bu izni sistem ayarlarından verebilirsiniz.
